historical_ties_before_2008: Keep published shared places. These years only supply historical features, not Plackett-Luce training rankings.
predecessor_countries: Keep CS (Serbia and Montenegro) separate from RS and ME. Do not transfer predecessor results.

voting.audit_method: Cross-check every public point and eligible candidate against the published final matrix. Review year-specific voting exceptions. Public channel is treated as a real national audience result unless the reviewed exception register flags a substitute; this is a source-audit classification, not an audit of raw telephone votes.
voting.unknown_policy: Fail on incomplete matrices, inconsistent candidate sets or an unclassified exception. Do not infer zero from a missing primary record.
voting.substitute_target_policy: Retain full group in national_votes with eligible_C=0 and target_first_place blank. Keep official_channel_winner only as an audit field.
voting.row_policy: Rest of the World goes to non_national_votes, outside national_votes and pair history.

geography.source: Natural Earth v5.1.2, 10m populated places and admin-0 boundary lines land
geography.capital_selection: Exactly one ADM0CAP=1 feature for each country ISO_A2. Use the source capital consistently, including Amsterdam, Podgorica and Jerusalem; preserve coordinates and NE_ID.
geography.distance: Haversine great-circle distance between source capital coordinates; log1p(distance_km).
geography.border: An explicit Natural Earth TYPE=Land line between the two ADM0_A3 country codes. Exclude water indicators. Do not merge separately coded territories or dependencies into the parent state.
geography.territory_examples: GB-IE=1; GB-ES=0 (Gibraltar separate), GB-CY=0 (sovereign bases separate), FR-NL=0 (Saint Martin/Sint Maarten separate); Denmark-Sweden bridge is not a land border.
geography.historical_stability: For the modeled countries and this admin-0 definition, the binary adjacency used in C is unchanged in 2016-2025. Changes to disputed lines in RU-UA, RU-GE and AM-AZ do not change the existence of a land border. Separate territories are not silently mapped to another participant.
geography.available_at: Static geographic facts, computed retrospectively from a pinned map. Contemporary populations and other time-varying map attributes are not used.
